profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BNSF | tech
profile.summary:
I am an enthusiastic Software Engineer who has a keen interest in full-stack web development with a passion for building high-performance products.  Constantly pushing myself to be a JavaScript ninja.

I have a natural drive for applying myself in the startup tech sector, and have structured my experiences accordingly.  I currently work at a small FinTech startup where I have led the initiative to streamline workflows on the platform by developing a system-wide notification engine.

When I am not engaged in academic pursuits, I enjoy mentoring high school students via a high-school Robotics program, where I help the students both academically and as a peer mentor.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer — Customer Facing
positions.description: Leading the Architectural Design & Implementation of Novel Customer Facing Applications

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Platform Integrations Lead
positions.description:
I currently lead the development of platform integrations.  I work mostly on our backend (NodeJS) systems yet seem to find myself also developing our user-facing platform (React).

- Led development of core platform integrations, architecting and maintaining scalable Node.js
backend services powering critical financial systems.

- Took full ownership of cross-technology solutions — from initial product specification
discussions with clients to architecture design, implementation, and long-term maintenance.

- Built and optimized RESTful APIs, real-time WebSocket APIs, and custom connectivity
frameworks ensuring seamless data exchange between internal and external platforms.

- Architected full-stack software solutions for Tier-1 Financial Institutions, delivering secure,
compliant, and high-performance systems under stringent reliability requirements.

- Developed and maintained React-based front-end features, tightly integrating them with
backend endpoints for cohesive, performant user experiences.

- Orchestrated entire AWS infrastructure, leveraging Docker to deploy compute across multiple
microservices, and leveraged Terraform to ensure architecture clarity.

- Spearheaded multiple code performance improvements, unlocking system scalability and long-
term maintainability while ensuring across key services.

- Successfully Established Novel Internal Coding Framework to ensure code quality amongst
senior and junior developers alike.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · TypeScript · JavaScript · Node.js · React.js · Front-End Development · Containerization

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Used Angular and PHP to develop a cloud-based financial SaaS product.

Established a Continuous Integration (CI) pipeline to ensure code reliability in production.

positions.title: Technical Analytics and Backend Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed and streamlined workflow via Tableau to inform data-driven business decisions.

Utilized PHP (Laravel framework) as the backend for a small-sized iOS application.

Leveraged test-driven development (TDD) principles to establish reliable codebase.

positions.title: Lead Design Mentor
positions.description:
Led the design of 6+ competitive robots via Solidworks 3D modeling software.

Managed a 30+ student engineering team using project management planning tools.

Won an engineering design and inspiration award for problem solving creativity.

positions.title: Process Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Led an investigation into current manufacturing capabilities to suggest dimensional control improvements.

Utilized Gage R&R Statstical Methods to quantify fabrication capabilities and suggest areas of improvement.

Suggested Improvements will yield an estimated $160k/year cost savings in aircraft engine casing manufacturing.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Intern
positions.description:
Investigated novel magneto-optical materials via a custom-designed electro-optical ellipsometer setup alongside a doctorate candidate.

Designed and fabricated testing platform using Solidworks CAD Software to improve upon graduate student’s previous iteration.

Simulated expected optics behavior of a Mach-Zehnder Interferometer using a parametric COMSOL simulation.

Participated and Won Two poster competitions, where the quality and presentation of the research was evaluated.

positions.title: Summer Research Assistant
positions.locationName: UCLA Center for Advanced Surgical and Interventional Technology
positions.description:
Developed an ultra-low profile Intracranial Nitinol (NiTi) stent to occlude damaged vessels, prevent excessive blood loss, and decrease recovery time.

Designed a 2D model of the device using AutoCAD.

Preliminary tests showed that the stent fixed a brain aneurism within 10.5 minutes.

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description:
-- Represented high school during outreach functions
-- Founded a tutoring system for students in Math and Science.

honors.title: Best in Research Award
honors.description:
Placed first in a poster competition, where I presented my work in pursuing a parametric COMSOL multiphysics study into the optic behavior of the test setup.  Also, I was able to generate an initial design for a device based off of the multiphysics study.

I competed alongside 30 peers.
honors.issuer: Issued by UCLA Center for Excellence in Engineering and Diversity · Aug 2013

honors.title: Best in Research Award
honors.description: Placed first in a poster competition, where I showcased my research in a mechanical engineering laboratory, specifically my ability to design and fabricate a high fidelity testing setup.  I competed alongside 30 peers.
honors.issuer: Issued by UCLA Center for Excellence in Engineering and Diversity · Aug 2012

volunteerExperiences.description:
Work with High School Students to:
1. Teach the fundamentals of Programming for the purpose of creating an efficient codebase that controls a robot.
2.  Help students with their personal growth (ie: Push them towards pursuing a STEM career in college)

projects.title: FIRST Robot
projects.description: I have taken the initiative to utilize fundamental Mechanical Engineering principles to design and fabricate a robust and versatile robot drivetrain.
